$comment: Docs-generation pipeline definition. Committed — same for everyone. Secrets and machine-specific values go in .env (see .env.example). Bump templateVersion ONLY when the page templates/standards change: it marks every generated page stale for a deliberate full regeneration.

kb.$comment: Knowledge-base export target (npm run docgen:kb-export). apiBasePath is prefixed to /auth/login, /kb/articles, etc. components is the product's controlled category vocabulary — page frontmatter `category` must match one of these exactly (keep in sync with the product's server-side list). Credentials live in .env (KB_BASE_URL, KB_USER, KB_PASS).
